<function name="OnSelect" parent="PropSelect" type="panelhook">
	<description>Called when the player selects a model.
</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<added>2024.09.02</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="pnl" type="Panel">The <page>Spawnicon</page> that was clicked.</arg>
		<arg name="model" type="string">Path of the selected model, or its "value".</arg>
	</args>
</function>
